correctness.rationale: Definitions, domain, all n>=1, excluded fixed face, and prime-versus-iterate distinction reconstructed from original exact coding. For a length-n word the matrix product has monomial shape and determinant 2^n. Tracking original coordinate labels verifies the exact signed exponent identity a-b=sum_{j=1}^n(-1)^{#R in first j}; odd R gives eigenvalues ±i*2^(n/2), even R gives diagonal ±2^a and ±2^b. The triangular change of variables from words to independent signs is bijective; deletion is exactly one all-L case; binomial count follows. Classical CLT with deletion of vanishing 2^(-n+1) mass gives the mixture. Complete exact integer enumeration through n=12 confirms intermediate matrix formulas but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source motivates statistical isotropy of vortex-like periodic expansion yet supplies only dichotomy and qualitative nonuniform expansion. The new complete finite-length distribution gives a natural spectral invariant (difference of log multiplier moduli) on the exact set of iterate-fixed points, and the mixed half-normal scaling law quantifies the typical anisotropy and its atom from rotating returns. It is a genuine quantitative cocycle-statistics result not obtained by merely rephrasing parity counts; no arbitrary parameter slice is introduced, since the planar map is the canonical first twisted-baker model.
